oneLiner: Turn your brand into unlimited on-brand content.
whatItDoes: An AI content platform that scripts, edits, analyzes and distributes on-brand videos, posts and campaigns straight from your Brand Vault. No templates — it generates from your brand.
proofPoints: one platform for the whole workflow
no templates — generated from your brand
visualStyle: Warm editorial dark. Near-black canvas (#0B0B0A), gold accent (#D4A652), off-white text, Plus Jakarta Sans headings. Premium and restrained: generous negative space, a faint grid, a soft gold glow, product-UI forward. Never neon, never busy, never cheap-gradient.
motionPersonality: Snappy but smooth — confident easing, tight staggers, subtle overshoot. Continuous, alive motion (never a static held frame). Camera moves with intent, not gratuitously. Think Linear/Apple restraint, not flashy.
